title: Item consumption is inconsistent: 'a jug of pitch-oil' vanished from inventory after burning the Gallows Glade, but 'a cask of cinder-oil' survived being poured over the Roofless Chapel and stayed in the pack the rest of the run.
where: Gallows Glade, Thornwold vs. The Roofless Chapel, Emberfall
